sqlquery.from:
( with myUserRoles as (select mu.id userID,r.code userRole from "$".myuser mu left join "$".myuser_role mr on mr.users_id=mu.id left join "$".role r on mr.roles_id=r.id and r.isdeleted is not true where mu.deleted is not true)
select l.id,l.creationDate,r.name sourceName, coalesce(l.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(l.lastname,'') leadName from "$".crmcontact l left join "$".reference r on l.source=r.id , (select id from "$".myuser where id=#?user_id?#) u left join (select userid ,max(case userRole when 'ADMIN' then 1 else 0 end)=1 isAdmin ,max(case userRole when 'SALESMAN' then 1 else 0 end)=1 isSalesman from myUserRoles group by userid)mur on u.id=mur.userid where l.contacttype=5 and l.deleted is not true and ( (true not in (mur.isAdmin, mur.isSalesman) and (u.id in (l.assignee,l.backupAssignee,l.owner))) or true in (mur.isAdmin, mur.isSalesman) ) ) t
